# Theekshitha Vadladi

Theekshitha Vadladi is a Vancouver, BC counselling intern offering in-person and online counselling through No Fear Counselling and An Elegant Mind Counselling Clinic.

Key facts:
- Name: Theekshitha Vadladi
- Credentials: BA, MA in progress
- Role: Master Level Counselling Intern / practicum student
- Supervision: Angela Leong, RCC (#16727)
- Education: Bachelor of Arts in Psychology, University of British Columbia, 2024; Master of Arts in Counselling Psychology in progress at Adler University
- Trainings: APT Level 2 CBT; Applied Suicide Intervention Skills Training (ASIST)
- Modalities: Acceptance and Commitment Therapy, Person-Centered Therapy, trauma-informed, culturally sensitive, humanistic, integrative, mindfulness-based, relational, somatic
- Focus areas: anxiety, life transitions, racial identity, cultural and systemic impacts, relationship issues, relational intimacy and connection, sexual wellness and agency, trauma integration, self-esteem, stress, depression
- Languages: English, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil
- Booking at No Fear Counselling: https://app.acuityscheduling.com/schedule.php?owner=11580739&appointmentType=category:Theekshitha
- Booking at An Elegant Mind Counselling Clinic: https://anelegantmindcounselling.janeapp.com/#/staff_member/41

Summary:
Theekshitha's counselling approach is warm, collaborative, person-centered, ACT-informed, and trauma-informed. She supports clients in reconnecting with their authentic selves after periods of survival, disconnection, emotional overwhelm, cultural stress, identity exploration, anxiety, and relational challenges.
